## What changes and why

## Checks

- [ ] `python scripts/sync.py` after any edit in `core/`
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] A user-facing document changed in English and in Polish (`.pl.md`)
- [ ] Every write a skill makes is shown first and runs with `--approved-by`
- [ ] Test data is synthetic: no real document, name, address or identifier
- [ ] Country-pack facts cite an act, a section and an official source
